ops.title: Investigate Drive install shared-lock starvation and lock ordering
ops.description: Owner root. User reported 1.0.463 shared installation locks starving an exclusive newer writer and possible inversion with durable-agents .lock. Quoted installer PID69732 was absent on fresh inspection. Current installer PID46424 sampled in subprocess poll, not flock, then completed installation 1.0.465; live land children reported installed 1.0.465. No processes signaled. Installed 1.0.464 state.py older_verbs_done waits exclusively on older install leases before acquiring drive .lock; hold_install retains shared lease across a verb. Next: inspect version-change ownership and an isolated hosted contention regression; prove any actual cycle or starvation before changing locking. Evidence drive-installer-lock.sample.txt and drive-controller-lock.sample.txt under cost-retro-20261102. Not a proven fix-live claim.
